name: AerioTV Presets
description: Preconfigure a user's AerioTV favorites, group order, hidden groups and categories, and app settings. Their AerioTV devices offer Dispatcharr Sync on first sign-in and start from this setup. Requires AerioTV 1.8.45 or newer on Apple devices and AerioTV for Android 0.5.14 or newer.
author: jonzey231

actions.label: Load
actions.description: Builds the channel and group lists for the chosen user. Save first, run this, then reload the page.

actions.label: Preview
actions.description: Shows what Apply would change, without writing.

actions.label: Apply
actions.description: Writes the setup to the user's AerioTV record.

confirm.title: Apply AerioTV setup?
confirm.message: This writes the user's AerioTV record. Replace mode overwrites what their devices saved for the sections you filled in.
